claims.sentence: A 12-week, randomized, placebo-controlled trial testing the efficacy of n-3 PUFA treatment (EPA, 2 g/day) in alleviating depressive symptoms in a subgroup of obese subjects with comorbid depression and low n-3 PUFA status (n-3 index \< 8%) (81), from the Taiwanese cohort.
